entry.title: October 2026: queries, charts and a faster editor
entry.summary: This release adds saved queries across the whole workspace, more chart types and a much quicker editor on long documents. Saved queries can filter...
entry.content:
This release adds saved queries across the whole workspace, more chart types and a much quicker editor on long documents.

  • Saved queries can filter every item you can read, not just one item's children.

  • Charts gain line, area, pie and a year grid.

  • Opening a 20,000-word document is about three times faster.

Fixes#

  • Calendar events keep their time zone when dragged across a daylight-saving change.

  • Locked items no longer show their children in search previews.

entry.title: September 2026: calendar sync and reminders
entry.summary: Two-way sync with Google and Outlook calendars, reminders on any dated item, and simple automations. Connect a calendar from workspace settings...
entry.content:
Two-way sync with Google and Outlook calendars, reminders on any dated item, and simple automations.

  • Connect a calendar from workspace settings; events become items you can link and comment on.

  • Reminders arrive as notifications on every signed-in device.

entry.title: August 2026: Markdown import
entry.summary: Bring an existing notes folder into Nix. Markdown files become items, folders become parents, and images come along.
entry.content:
Bring an existing notes folder into Nix. Markdown files become items, folders become parents, and images come along.

nixctl import ./notes --into "Imported notes"
